answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, with the stake slashed if its work is proven fake. A newcomer must cross a costly bridge: one identity, one bond, verified over time, so spawning thousands of Sybil copies multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of giving free votes. A lightweight quill record — a signed history of completed jobs — then lets others trust the bonded identity without trusting its name alone.
